title: debark policy v1
description: debark.policy/v1 - a local, operator-owned policy file evaluated against a resolved plan. Every field is optional: an empty policy is valid and finds nothing. This schema validates the JSON-equivalent structure of the policy file; debark's own policy files are conventionally authored as YAML, whose keys are identical to the json field names below.

allow_components.description: When non-empty, the exhaustive list of archive components packages may come from (main, universe, ...). Anything else produces a finding at default_severity.

deny_components.description: Archive components that must not appear at all.

allow_packages.description: Name glob patterns a package must match to be allowed.

deny_packages.description: Name glob patterns a package must not match.

require_signed_publisher.description: When true, denies any file whose publisher_verification is url-unverified.

allow_url_inputs.description: Whether vendor URL inputs are permitted at all. Defaults to true when absent.

approved_keys.description: Inline approved archive key fingerprint list, uppercase hex, equivalent to --approved-keys.

deny_flags.description: Denies any package carrying one of these lock flags.

default_severity.description: Severity applied to rules that do not state their own. Defaults to warn when absent.
